hazards.description: The cobblestone roadway presents an uneven surface that may be difficult for pedestrians with mobility aids or strollers to navigate if crossing.

hazards.name: Driveway Conflict Point
hazards.description: A gated driveway crosses the sidewalk, creating potential conflicts between pedestrians and vehicles entering or exiting the site.
hazards.location_in_image: Left-center, where the gate and driveway intersect the sidewalk.

hazards.name: Uneven sidewalk surface
hazards.description: The cobblestone sidewalk on the left side of the image may be difficult to navigate for individuals with mobility aids or strollers.

hazards.name: Uneven Pavement and Tram Tracks
hazards.description: The combination of cobblestones and embedded metal tracks creates significant tripping hazards and slippery surfaces for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Streetcar Tracks
hazards.description: Tracks in the roadway can be slippery and create tripping or catching hazards for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Wide Driveway Conflict Zone
hazards.description: A very wide curb cut for a commercial driveway creates a large area where pedestrians are exposed to turning vehicles without clear priority.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground, where the asphalt driveway meets the cobblestone street.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Priority Markings
hazards.description: No crosswalk markings or signage exist to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians crossing the driveway entrance.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the mouth of the driveway between the two buildings.

hazards.name: Lack of Buffer
hazards.description: There is no physical separation, such as trees or bollards, between the pedestrian walkway and the vehicle travel lane.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line throughout the visible block.

hazards.name: Wide Driveway Apron
hazards.description: An excessively wide curb cut for the gas station creates a large conflict zone where vehicles and pedestrians share space without clear priority.
hazards.location_in_image: Center right, entrance to the gas station

hazards.name: Sidewalk Debris
hazards.description: Piles of debris and trash are obstructing the walkway near the fence line.
hazards.location_in_image: Center left, adjacent to the mural building

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossing
hazards.description: Despite commercial activity that generates pedestrian trips, there are no marked crossings or pedestrian-oriented signage.

hazards.name: Embedded Tram Tracks
hazards.description: Metal tracks in the roadway can be slippery when wet and pose a tripping hazard or a risk for bicycle tires.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway extending from foreground to background

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Large Vehicle
hazards.description: A large red semi-truck is parked along the curb, completely blocking the view of the roadway for pedestrians and the view of pedestrians for drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, occupying the parking lane.

hazards.name: Lack of Passive Surveillance
hazards.description: The buildings have blank walls with no windows or active entrances at street level, reducing the sense of safety.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and center background, the building facades.

hazards.name: Large vehicle visual obstruction
hazards.description: A large semi-truck parked or moving on the left side of the image significantly blocks sightlines between pedestrians and other road users.

hazards.name: Tram track tripping hazard
hazards.description: Embedded tram tracks and uneven pavement patches between them create tripping hazards for pedestrians attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Utility pole obstruction
hazards.description: A large utility pole is located directly in the center of the sidewalk, blocking the clear path of travel and creating a hazard for people with mobility aids or visual impairments.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground on the concrete sidewalk

hazards.name: Wide uncontrolled driveway
hazards.description: The gas station entrance creates a very wide, undefined conflict zone where pedestrians must cross vehicle paths without any protection or clear markings.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the sidewalk leading into the Sunoco station

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks with appropriate signage to provide safe crossing points for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at potential crossing points to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Lane Markings
interventions.description: Apply clear lane markings to organize traffic flow and narrow the perceived travel lane width to encourage slower speeds.

interventions.title: Establish a Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Consolidate utility boxes and poles into a dedicated furniture zone or planting strip to clear the primary walking path.

interventions.title: Install Curb Extensions or Planters
interventions.description: Add physical buffers like planters or curb extensions to increase separation between pedestrians and vehicles and improve the streetscape.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at the intersection to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signals at the intersection to provide clear timing for crossing.

interventions.title: Clear Sidewalk Obstructions
interventions.description: Remove construction debris and materials to restore the full width of the pedestrian walkway.

interventions.title: Install Street Lighting
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety at night.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Add street trees or planters to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Supplement existing tall street lights with lower-level pedestrian-scale lighting to improve visibility and safety at night.

interventions.title: Install a sidewalk buffer
interventions.description: Add a planting strip, street furniture, or bollards to provide physical and psychological separation between pedestrians and vehicles.

interventions.title: Improve pedestrian-scale lighting

interventions.title: Street Lighting Installation
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping

interventions.title: Active Frontage Encouragement
interventions.description: Future development should encourage windows and entrances facing the street to improve natural surveillance.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Buffers
interventions.description: Increase the width of the walkway and add a furniture zone or planting strip to separate pedestrians from traffic.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Green Buffer
interventions.description: Install street trees or a planted buffer zone between the sidewalk and the curb to provide shade, improve aesthetics, and increase the physical separation from the roadway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Repair cracks and uneven sections of the concrete sidewalk to ensure a smooth, trip-free walking surface.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a safe crossing point.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Leveling
interventions.description: Ensure the cobblestone walkway meets ADA accessibility standards or provide a smoother paved path within the walkway zone.

interventions.title: Install Street Trees or Planters
interventions.description: Adding a line of street trees or large planters would create a vertical buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway, improving safety and comfort.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance and Management
interventions.description: Establish regular debris removal and ensure the walkway remains clear of commercial or residential waste.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Driveway Markings
interventions.description: Apply high-visibility paint or contrasting materials to the sidewalk where it crosses the driveway to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Install street trees or a planting strip between the curb and the sidewalk to provide a physical buffer from traffic and improve the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Treatment
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk material and level across the driveway to clearly signal pedestrian priority and slow entering/exiting vehicles.

interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the driveway entrance using curb extensions to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install painted crosswalk markings across the driveway to improve driver awareness of pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance
interventions.description: Clear all debris and caution tape from the walkway and repair cracked or uneven concrete slabs to ensure a level and unobstructed path.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Protection
interventions.description: Install bollards or street furniture to prevent vehicles from parking on and obstructing the pedestrian walkway.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint and signage to provide a designated crossing point.

interventions.title: Streetscape Improvements
interventions.description: Add street furniture, planters, or trees to create a buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Loading Zone Management
interventions.description: Designate specific loading zones for large vehicles to prevent them from obstructing sightlines near pedestrian areas.

interventions.title: Relocate Utility Infrastructure
interventions.description: Move the utility pole to the edge of the sidewalk or underground to ensure a continuous, unobstructed clear zone for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing and Apron Design
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the gas station entrance and use a continuous sidewalk material/level to slow turning vehicles and reinforce pedestrian priority.
